allowed_interventions.description: 按任务生成原创规划或起草，尊重既有事实与授权的诗学。

forbidden_interventions.description: 不得加入：三案都是同一个幕后组织策划。

deterministic_assertions.pattern: ^三案都是同一个幕后组织策划。?\s*$

pointwise_questions: Does the candidate execute the requested stage rather than repeat labels?
Is progression / accumulation concrete and authorized?
Are mediation, closure and temporal form kept independent?
Does each chapter inherit and contribute without compulsory escalation?
Does prose realize the declared reader task?
Are hard facts and every forbidden intervention respected?
model_evaluation.pairwise_question: Which candidate better executes this task under the declared project without importing generic house style?
model_evaluation.tie_policy: Use tie only when both candidates satisfy or violate the contract to essentially the same degree; do not reward verbosity, conventional polish, explanation, or dramatic escalation by default.
